about_the_game:
What is Saqer’s Paradox - Promo?
Saqer’s Paradox - Promo is a free 2.5D action-adventure RPG demo that offers a sneak peek into the world of the full game currently in development. Inspired by the cooperative puzzle-solving of Four Swords Adventure and the stunning HD pixel art style of Octopath Traveler, this promo lets you experience core mechanics such as combat, NPC interaction, and controls. It’s a taste of what’s to come—designed to give players a feel for the gameplay and atmosphere ahead of the full release. It’s a handcrafted love letter to pixel-art enthusiasts and classic RPG fans—built from scratch with an original world, vision, and style.

Explore and Conquer
Delve into massive, atmospheric environments—from ancient dungeons and awe-inspiring castles to sprawling ruins. The level is meticulously designed to evoke scale and wonder, combining environmental storytelling with layered pixel depth.

Engage in Precise Combat
Battle in real time with tight, skill-based combat infused with strategic depth. Face off against foes and stubborn enemies that reward timing, positioning, and mastery of your abilities.

Built With Passion—Pixel by Pixel
Every sprite, texture, and animation is hand-crafted—no AI art, no stock assets, and no shortcuts. The pixel art is sharp, detailed, and animated with precision to capture the nostalgia of retro games while delivering modern polish.

Original. Playable. Community-Driven.
Saqer’s Paradox - Promo is 100% original—no borrowed assets or IPs—so you can support it without fear of takedowns. It is created solo over seven months by a full-time bank software engineer with no prior Unreal Engine experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz (e.g. Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2)
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Game runs on low-end hardware; controller supported
